items.title: Cloudflare and VoidZero Introduce tsrs: an AI-Generated Rust Port of TypeScript
items.blurb: Cloudflare, VoidZero and Max Schwenk announced tsrs, an experimental Rust port of the TypeScript compiler, built with the TypeScript team's involvement.

items.title: Deploy with Void
items.blurb: Introducing Void: an open-source SDK, CLI, and self-hosted platform for building full-stack Vite apps and deploying them to Cloudflare.

items.title: Under the hood, off the hot path: How D1 scales to millions of databases
items.blurb: A deep dive into how D1 architected its control plane to scale and manage millions of databases, while keeping data plane query operations at the edge. We share guiding principles on how to build on the Developer Platform effectively.

Stripe on Stripe: What we learned moving $1B in vendor payments to Global Payouts
items.blurb: In early 2026, we began moving our vendor payments to Global Payouts, Stripe’s product for paying recipients in 160+ countries. New-market setup fell from six weeks to one, with a 99.9% payout success rate. Here’s what we learned.
